summary: Lando Norris won the São Paulo Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 0.8s ahead of Kimi Antonelli, with George Russell completing the podium.
Esteban Ocon made the biggest climb, from P18 to P11.
Nico Hulkenberg had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P16.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag and 1 safety car.
There were 19 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Lando Norris leads the championship by 9 points over Oscar Piastri.
